title: Wildheart seeded as an in-house program Space

source.ref: Owner ruling 2026-10-12: set up Wildheart as if it had gone through the seeding process, like Hearts on Fire; stock theme, website published by hand

detail:
The Wildheart Space (spaces.id 5c7c46d1-a2ba-4e58-a942-c1fe6a68e74b) was created on 2026-10-12 with the typo slug `wilheart`, plan free, no about, no preferences, one empty primary circle and no events, journeys or program. scripts/seed-wildheart.sql (one idempotent transaction, generated by `pnpm seed:wildheart --sql` from scripts/seed-wildheart.mts, the REST twin) seeds it the way Hearts on Fire is seeded: the Space row (slug wildheart, collective, limits_waived, dawn, network, America/Los_Angeles, HoF's entitlement keys, preferences pages/pageDocs/siteHero/profileData/profileLayout/programOverview/profilePublished; theme and websitePublished deliberately absent), the circle renamed Wildheart Circle One at capacity 12, the Circle Night anchor (FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2;BYDAY=TU from Tue 2026-11-03 18:00 PT) plus its first 60 days of occurrences as the cron mints them, the eight Foundation Tuesdays, the festivals, moons and Hearth Gatherings from the owner-approved 2027 ritual calendar, the Samhain retreat as one multi-day event, two Journeys (Wildheart Foundation: 8 phases, 8 modules, 8 lessons; The Wildheart Year: ongoing, drip 30, 12 phases, 12 modules) and the Program (circle_templates blueprint + topical_channels + circle_channels). Logo and cover are NOT written: the SQL names the library-media bucket path and the UPDATE to run after the upload. The owner applies the SQL by hand; this row closes once the VERIFY selects in the file return the expected counts.

Seed applied to production in chunks on 2026-10-12; every VERIFY expectation in scripts/seed-wildheart.sql met (57 events, 2 journeys 8/8/8 and 12/12/0, program linked). Logo and cover remain an owner upload.

verify.evidence: Applied to production on 2026-10-12 through the Supabase SQL API in idempotent chunks of the generated scripts/seed-wildheart.sql (the owner's SQL-editor paste did not land; counts were 0/0 before). VERIFY selects on spaces.id 5c7c46d1-a2ba-4e58-a942-c1fe6a68e74b returned: slug wildheart, plan collective, limits_waived t, skin dawn, visibility network, time_zone America/Los_Angeles, preferences without theme and without websitePublished, profilePublished true, 6 pages, 6 pageDocs, programOverview present (8807 chars). circles: 1 row, Wildheart Circle One, member_cap 12, primary_pillar body. events: 57 total, 1 recurring anchor, 4 occurrences with parent_event_id, 8 with journey_id, 30 moon circles, 1 multi-day retreat. journey_plans: wildheart-foundation 8 phases / 8 modules / 8 lessons, ongoing f, drip 7; the-wildheart-year 12 phases / 12 modules, ongoing t, drip 30. topical_channels owned by the Space: 1 row (slug wildheart, category movement) and the circle's topical_channel_id points at it. Logo and cover still to be uploaded through Manage > Branding.
